claims.claim_text: The indexed Doda Conrad is a high-confidence match to the singer born in 1905 who entered the U.S. Army in 1942.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Doda Conrad, born February 19, 1905, who had a career as a baritone
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The rare exact name, 1905 birth year and 1942 American Army chronology agree across the index, official Army file and two independent institutional biographies.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact rare name and matching birth year and Army year provide multiple corroborating identifiers, but the index's seven-digit identifier does not occur in the enlisted merged file and no personnel file was reviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army row dates entry to 13 July 1942; the institutional sources establish a prior singing career but do not date OSS entry.
claims.match_notes: High confidence, not confirmed: Box 140 remains necessary to interpret the index identifier and document the exact Army-to-OSS linkage.
